description.value: Aspen Inn and Suites is a motel situated on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16) in Smithers, BC, a strategic overnight stop roughly midway between Prince George and Prince Rupert on a popular touring corridor. The property includes an on-site full-service restaurant and lounge (Aspen Riverhouse) capable of hosting large groups. Rooms feature microwaves and fridges, and the property offers pool and hot tub access.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the business is operating: it lists amenities (Wifi, Pool & Hot Tub Access, Restaurant, Pet friendly, Wheelchair Accessible), contact details matching OSM, and an on-site restaurant (Aspen Riverhouse). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. Wi-Fi is confirmed both by OSM (internet_access=wlan) and the website amenity list. The website address is '4268 Highway 16' while OSM uses '4268 Yellowhead Highway' — Highway 16 is the Yellowhead Highway, so these are equivalent.
concerns: OSM address uses 'Yellowhead Highway'; website uses 'Highway 16' — these are the same road but the naming differs. No material discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel on a major BC touring highway with confirmed amenities and website presence.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Aspen Riverhouse Restaurant & Lounge serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner; accommodates parties up to 150
